name: Phthalate
aliases: phthalates, ortho-phthalates, DEHP, DBP, BBP, DINP, DIDP, DCHP, DIOP, dicyclohexyl phthalate, diisooctyl phthalate, phthalic acid esters, plasticizers, ftalatos
what_is: A group of ortho-phthalate chemicals used mainly as plasticizers in certain food-contact materials. FDA states that phthalates are not authorised for direct addition to food.
why_botia: EFSA's 2019 food-contact review assessed DBP, BBP, DEHP, DINP and DIDP. In May 2026, FDA evaluated eight currently authorised food-contact plasticizers and proposed grouping DEHP, DCHP, DIOP and DINP for a future cumulative risk assessment. DCHP and DIOP therefore belong in BOTIA's explanatory coverage, but this remains packaging/contact-material context rather than a normal ingredient-list trigger.
can_1: Recognise explicit phthalate names, including DCHP and DIOP, when they are printed in packaging or material information visible to BOTIA.
can_2: Explain the current EFSA and FDA food-contact context without claiming that an ingredient list reveals migration into the food.
cannot_1: Detect or quantify phthalates that have migrated into food from packaging using label OCR.
cannot_2: Conclude that food contains a particular phthalate when the chemical is not explicitly declared in readable packaging/material information.

sources.label: EFSA — Update of the risk assessment of phthalates for use in food contact materials (2019)
FDA — Phthalates in Food Packaging and Food Contact Applications (updated 2026)

title: Phthalates
description: Ortho-phthalate plasticizers in food-contact materials, expanded to include DCHP and DIOP.
